question_en: Which statements are true? 1) like magnetic poles attract; 2) by cutting a magnet one can obtain a magnet with a single pole; 3) parallel currents in the same direction attract; 4) the field lines of the magnetic field of a current are closed; 5) the Earth's magnetic and geographic poles coincide.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) bir ismli magnit qutblar tortishadi; 2) magnitni bo'lib, bitta qutbli magnit olish mumkin; 3) bir yo'nalishli parallel toklar tortishadi; 4) tok magnit maydonining induksiya chiziqlari berk; 5) Yerning magnit va geografik qutblari ustma-ust tushadi.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) одноимённые магнитные полюсы притягиваются; 2) разделив магнит, можно получить магнит с одним полюсом; 3) одинаково направленные параллельные токи притягиваются; 4) линии индукции магнитного поля тока замкнуты; 5) магнитные и географические полюсы Земли совпадают.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Bir ismli qutblar itarishadi, monopol yo'q, Yer qutblari mos emas; bir yo'nalishli toklar tortishadi, chiziqlar berk.
Asos: magnit maydon xossalari.

rules.en: Currents in the same direction attract: $\uparrow\uparrow$

distractors.A: eng ko'p uchraydigan noto'g'ri tasavvurlar tanlangan
distractors.D: magnit monopol va qutblar mosligi to'g'ri deb olingan
distractors.E: 5-fikr to'g'ri deb olingan — qutblar mos kelmaydi

distractors_ru.D: монополь и совпадение полюсов приняты за верные
distractors_ru.E: утверждение 5 принято за верное — полюсы не совпадают

distractors_en.A: the most common misconceptions were chosen
distractors_en.D: the monopole and the coincidence of poles were taken as true
distractors_en.E: statement 5 was taken as true — the poles do not coincide

question_en: The distance from a straight current to the observation point was increased $3$ times. Find the ratio of the magnetic inductions $\frac{B_2}{B_1}$.
question_uz: To'g'ri tokdan kuzatilayotgan nuqtagacha masofa $3$ marta orttirildi. Magnit induksiyalar nisbati $\frac{B_2}{B_1}$ ni toping.
question_ru: Расстояние от прямого тока до точки наблюдения увеличили в $3$ раза. Найдите отношение магнитных индукций $\frac{B_2}{B_1}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. To'g'ri tok uchun B = μ₀I/(2πr), ya'ni B ∼ 1/r: masofa 3 marta ortsa, B 3 marta kamayadi.
Asos: to'g'ri tok maydoni.

rules.en: Field of a straight current: $B=\frac{\mu_0I}{2\pi r}$

distractors.D: r² ga to'g'ri proporsional deb olingan
distractors.E: B masofaga bog'liq emas deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: взята зависимость 1/r², как у точечного заряда
distractors_ru.E: принято, что B не зависит от расстояния

distractors_en.A: a 1/r² dependence was used, as for a point charge
distractors_en.E: B was assumed not to depend on distance

question_en: A current of $25\ \mathrm{A}$ flows in an infinitely long straight conductor. Find the magnetic induction at a point $10\ \mathrm{cm}$ from it ($\mu\mathrm{T}$). $\mu_0=4\pi\cdot10^{-7}\ \mathrm{T\cdot m/A}$.
question_uz: Cheksiz uzun to'g'ri o'tkazgichdan $25\ \mathrm{A}$ tok o'tmoqda. Undan $10\ \mathrm{cm}$ masofadagi nuqtada magnit induksiyani toping ($\mu\mathrm{T}$). $\mu_0=4\pi\cdot10^{-7}\ \mathrm{T\cdot m/A}$.
question_ru: По бесконечно длинному прямому проводнику течёт ток $25\ \mathrm{A}$. Найдите магнитную индукцию в точке на расстоянии $10\ \mathrm{cm}$ от него ($\mu\mathrm{T}$). $\mu_0=4\pi\cdot10^{-7}\ \mathrm{T\cdot m/A}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. B = μ₀I/(2πr) = 2·10⁻⁷·25/0,1 = 5·10⁻⁵ T = 50 μT.
Asos: to'g'ri tok maydoni.

rules.en: Field of a straight current: $B=\frac{\mu_0I}{2\pi r}$

distractors.D: masofa metrga o'tkazilmagan, r = 1 deb olingan

distractors_en.B: the distance was taken as 1 cm
distractors_en.C: twice the distance (a diameter) was used
distractors_en.D: the distance was not converted, r = 1 was used
distractors_en.E: the ring-centre formula μ₀I/(2r) was used

question_en: Two mutually perpendicular uniform magnetic fields with inductions $0.9\ \mathrm{T}$ and $1.2\ \mathrm{T}$ were superposed. Find the induction of the resultant field ($\mathrm{T}$).
question_uz: Induksiyalari $0.9\ \mathrm{T}$ va $1.2\ \mathrm{T}$ bo'lgan o'zaro perpendikulyar ikki bir jinsli magnit maydon qo'shildi. Natijaviy maydon induksiyasini toping ($\mathrm{T}$).
question_ru: Сложили два взаимно перпендикулярных однородных магнитных поля с индукциями $0.9\ \mathrm{T}$ и $1.2\ \mathrm{T}$. Найдите индукцию результирующего поля ($\mathrm{T}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Induksiyalar vektor sifatida qo'shiladi: B = √(0,9² + 1,2²) = √2,25 = 1,5 T.
Asos: superpozitsiya prinsipi.

distractors_en.E: the result was divided by two

question_en: A current of $10\ \mathrm{A}$ flows in a wire ring of radius $5\ \mathrm{cm}$. Find the magnetic induction at the centre of the ring ($\mu\mathrm{T}$).
question_uz: Radiusi $5\ \mathrm{cm}$ bo'lgan sim halqadan $10\ \mathrm{A}$ tok o'tmoqda. Halqa markazidagi magnit induksiyani toping ($\mu\mathrm{T}$).
question_ru: По проволочному кольцу радиусом $5\ \mathrm{cm}$ течёт ток $10\ \mathrm{A}$. Найдите магнитную индукцию в центре кольца ($\mu\mathrm{T}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. B = μ₀I/(2R) = 4π·10⁻⁷·10/0,1 = 40π·10⁻⁶ T = 40π μT ≈ 126 μT.
Asos: aylanma tok markazidagi maydon.

distractors_en.A: the semicircle formula μ₀I/(4R) was used
distractors_en.B: the 2 in the denominator was dropped
distractors_en.C: the radius was taken as 50 cm
distractors_en.D: the radius was taken as 0.5 cm

question_en: A current of $0.5\ \mathrm{A}$ flows in a solenoid of length $15\ \mathrm{cm}$ with $300$ turns. Find the magnetic field strength inside the solenoid ($\mathrm{A/m}$).
question_uz: Uzunligi $15\ \mathrm{cm}$, o'ramlar soni $300$ bo'lgan solenoiddan $0.5\ \mathrm{A}$ tok o'tmoqda. Solenoid ichidagi magnit maydon kuchlanganligini toping ($\mathrm{A/m}$).
question_ru: По соленоиду длиной $15\ \mathrm{cm}$ с числом витков $300$ течёт ток $0.5\ \mathrm{A}$. Найдите напряжённость магнитного поля внутри соленоида ($\mathrm{A/m}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. H = nI = NI/l = 300·0,5/0,15 = 1000 A/m.
Asos: solenoid ichidagi maydon kuchlanganligi H = nI.

distractors_ru.E: поделено на два, как в формуле кольца

distractors_en.A: it was not divided by the length (NI)
distractors_en.C: the length was left in centimetres
distractors_en.D: the result was multiplied by two
distractors_en.E: it was divided by two, as in the ring formula

question_en: In a uniform field of induction $1.5\ \mathrm{T}$ a current of $5\ \mathrm{A}$ flows in a conductor of length $12\ \mathrm{cm}$. The angle between the current and $\vec B$ is $30^\circ$. Find the Ampère force ($\mathrm{N}$).
question_uz: Induksiyasi $1.5\ \mathrm{T}$ bo'lgan bir jinsli maydonda $12\ \mathrm{cm}$ uzunlikdagi o'tkazgichdan $5\ \mathrm{A}$ tok o'tmoqda. Tok va $\vec B$ orasidagi burchak $30^\circ$. Amper kuchini toping ($\mathrm{N}$).
question_ru: В однородном поле с индукцией $1.5\ \mathrm{T}$ по проводнику длиной $12\ \mathrm{cm}$ течёт ток $5\ \mathrm{A}$. Угол между током и $\vec B$ равен $30^\circ$. Найдите силу Ампера ($\mathrm{N}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. F = IBl·sinα = 5·1,5·0,12·0,5 = 0,45 N.
Asos: Amper qonuni F = IBl·sinα.

distractors_en.A: sinα was not taken into account
distractors_en.B: the cosine was used instead of the sine
distractors_en.D: the length was left in centimetres

question_en: The angle between a current-carrying conductor and the field lines was increased from $30^\circ$ to $90^\circ$. Find the ratio of the Ampère forces $\frac{F_2}{F_1}$.
question_uz: Tokli o'tkazgich bilan induksiya chiziqlari orasidagi burchak $30^\circ$ dan $90^\circ$ gacha orttirildi. Amper kuchlari nisbati $\frac{F_2}{F_1}$ ni toping.
question_ru: Угол между проводником с током и линиями индукции увеличили с $30^\circ$ до $90^\circ$. Найдите отношение сил Ампера $\frac{F_2}{F_1}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. F ∼ sinα: F₂/F₁ = sin90°/sin30° = 1/0,5 = 2.
Asos: Amper qonuni F = IBl·sinα.

en: The force is proportional to the sine of the angle: $$\frac{F_2}{F_1}=\frac{\sin90^\circ}{\sin30^\circ}=\frac{1}{0.5}=2$$

distractors.B: kuch burchakning o'ziga proporsional deb olingan
distractors.E: kuch burchakka bog'liq emas deb olingan

distractors_ru.E: принято, что сила не зависит от угла

distractors_en.B: the force was taken as proportional to the angle itself
distractors_en.C: it was computed as if the angle grew to 60°
distractors_en.E: the force was assumed not to depend on the angle

question_en: A straight current-carrying conductor is in a uniform field. The magnetic induction was decreased $4$ times, the active length of the conductor was increased $2$ times and the current $6$ times. Find the ratio of the Ampère forces $\frac{F_2}{F_1}$.
question_uz: Bir jinsli maydonda tokli to'g'ri o'tkazgich joylashgan. Magnit induksiya $4$ marta kamaytirildi, o'tkazgichning aktiv uzunligi $2$ marta, tok kuchi $6$ marta orttirildi. Amper kuchlari nisbati $\frac{F_2}{F_1}$ ni toping.
question_ru: В однородном поле находится прямой проводник с током. Магнитную индукцию уменьшили в $4$ раза, активную длину проводника увеличили в $2$ раза, а силу тока — в $6$ раз. Найдите отношение сил Ампера $\frac{F_2}{F_1}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. F = IBl·sinα: F₂/F₁ = 6·2·(1/4) = 3 marta ortadi.
Asos: Amper qonuni — kuch I, B, l ga proporsional.

distractors_ru.C: принято, что индукция выросла в 4 раза

distractors_en.A: the change in induction was ignored
distractors_en.C: the induction was assumed to increase 4 times
distractors_en.E: the change in current was ignored

question_en: The figure shows a current-carrying conductor in a uniform magnetic field: the current is perpendicular to the page, away from us ($\otimes$), the field lines point to the right. What is the direction of the Ampère force?
question_uz: Rasmda bir jinsli magnit maydondagi tokli o'tkazgich ko'rsatilgan: tok chizma tekisligiga perpendikulyar ravishda bizdan uzoqlashadi ($\otimes$), induksiya chiziqlari o'ngga yo'nalgan. Amper kuchi qanday yo'nalgan?
question_ru: На рисунке показан проводник с током в однородном магнитном поле: ток направлен перпендикулярно плоскости рисунка от нас ($\otimes$), линии индукции направлены вправо. Как направлена сила Ампера?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Chap qo'l: chiziqlar kaftga kiradi, to'rt barmoq tok bo'ylab (bizdan) — bosh barmoq pastga. F = I·l × B ham pastga.
Asos: chap qo'l qoidasi.

uz: Chap qo'l qoidasi yoki vektor ko'paytma: $$\vec l\uparrow\uparrow(-z),\ \vec B\uparrow\uparrow x:\ \ \vec l\times\vec B\uparrow\uparrow(-y)$$
ru: Правило левой руки или векторное произведение: $$\vec l\uparrow\uparrow(-z),\ \vec B\uparrow\uparrow x:\ \ \vec l\times\vec B\uparrow\uparrow(-y)$$
en: Left-hand rule or cross product: $$\vec l\uparrow\uparrow(-z),\ \vec B\uparrow\uparrow x:\ \ \vec l\times\vec B\uparrow\uparrow(-y)$$

rules.uz: Chap qo'l qoidasi: $\vec F=I\,\vec l\times\vec B$
rules.ru: Правило левой руки: $\vec F=I\,\vec l\times\vec B$

distractors.A: o'ng qo'l qoidasi ishlatilgan — yo'nalish teskari
distractors.B: kuch B ga qarama-qarshi deb olingan
distractors.C: kuch B bo'ylab yo'nalgan deb olingan
distractors.D: tok B ga perpendikulyar bo'lsa ham kuch nol deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: использовано правило правой руки — направление обратное
distractors_ru.D: сила принята равной нулю, хотя ток перпендикулярен B

distractors_en.A: the right-hand rule was used — the direction is reversed
distractors_en.B: the force was taken opposite to B
distractors_en.C: the force was taken along B
distractors_en.D: the force was taken as zero, although the current is perpendicular to B

question_en: The figure shows a long straight conductor lying in the plane of the page, with the current directed upwards. What is the direction of the magnetic induction vector at point $A$, located to the right of the conductor?
question_uz: Rasmda chizma tekisligida yotgan uzun to'g'ri o'tkazgich ko'rsatilgan, tok yuqoriga yo'nalgan. O'tkazgichdan o'ngda joylashgan $A$ nuqtada magnit induksiya vektori qanday yo'nalgan?
question_ru: На рисунке показан длинный прямой проводник, лежащий в плоскости рисунка, ток направлен вверх. Как направлен вектор магнитной индукции в точке $A$, расположенной справа от проводника?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Parma qoidasi: parma yuqoriga ilgarilasa, dastasi o'ng tomonda bizdan uzoqlashadi — B chizmaga kiradi (⊗).
Asos: parma qoidasi.

uz: Parma qoidasi: $\vec B$ tokni o'rab oladi: $$\vec I\uparrow\uparrow y,\ \vec r\uparrow\uparrow x:\ \ \vec I\times\vec r\uparrow\uparrow(-z)\ \Rightarrow\ \otimes$$
ru: Правило буравчика: $\vec B$ охватывает ток: $$\vec I\uparrow\uparrow y,\ \vec r\uparrow\uparrow x:\ \ \vec I\times\vec r\uparrow\uparrow(-z)\ \Rightarrow\ \otimes$$
en: Corkscrew rule: $\vec B$ circles the current: $$\vec I\uparrow\uparrow y,\ \vec r\uparrow\uparrow x:\ \ \vec I\times\vec r\uparrow\uparrow(-z)\ \Rightarrow\ \otimes$$

rules.uz: Parma qoidasi: $\vec B$ tokni o'rab, aylana bo'ylab yo'nalgan
rules.ru: Правило буравчика: $\vec B$ направлен по окружности вокруг тока
rules.en: Corkscrew rule: $\vec B$ circles around the current

distractors.C: B tok bo'ylab yo'nalgan deb olingan
distractors.D: B radius bo'ylab yo'nalgan deb olingan
distractors.E: tok tekisligida maydon yo'q deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: буравчик вращали в обратную сторону (взята левая рука)
distractors_ru.E: принято, что в плоскости тока поля нет

distractors_en.A: the corkscrew was turned the wrong way (the left hand was used)
distractors_en.C: B was taken along the current
distractors_en.D: B was taken along the radius
distractors_en.E: it was assumed there is no field in the plane of the current

question_en: Equal currents flow away from us ($\otimes$) in two long parallel conductors perpendicular to the page. Point $A$ is above the midpoint of the segment joining the conductors, at equal distances from them. What is the direction of the resultant induction at point $A$?
question_uz: Chizma tekisligiga perpendikulyar ikki uzun parallel o'tkazgichdan bir xil tok bizdan uzoqlashuvchi yo'nalishda ($\otimes$) o'tmoqda. $A$ nuqta o'tkazgichlar orasidagi kesma o'rtasidan yuqorida, ulardan teng masofada. $A$ nuqtadagi natijaviy induksiya qanday yo'nalgan?
question_ru: По двум длинным параллельным проводникам, перпендикулярным плоскости рисунка, текут одинаковые токи в направлении от нас ($\otimes$). Точка $A$ находится над серединой отрезка, соединяющего проводники, на одинаковом расстоянии от них. Как направлена результирующая индукция в точке $A$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Har bir tok maydoni soat mili bo'ylab aylanadi; A da vertikal tashkil etuvchilar yo'qoladi, gorizontallari qo'shiladi — o'ngga.
Asos: superpozitsiya.

ru: Строим и складываем два вектора: $$B_{1y}=-B_{2y},\qquad B_x=B_{1x}+B_{2x}>0$$
en: Draw and add the two vectors: $$B_{1y}=-B_{2y},\qquad B_x=B_{1x}+B_{2x}>0$$

distractors.A: ikki vektor yo'nalishi radius bo'ylab olingan
distractors.B: ikki vektor yo'nalishi radius bo'ylab, markazga qarab olingan
distractors.E: o'rtadagi nuqtadagi natija (B = 0) A ga ko'chirilgan

distractors_ru.B: векторы взяты по радиусам к центру
distractors_ru.E: результат для середины (B = 0) перенесён на A

distractors_en.A: the vectors were taken along the radii
distractors_en.B: the vectors were taken along the radii towards the centre
distractors_en.D: the corkscrew was turned the wrong way
distractors_en.E: the midpoint result (B = 0) was carried over to A

question_en: In vacuum, currents of $10\ \mathrm{A}$ and $15\ \mathrm{A}$ flow in two long parallel conductors $5\ \mathrm{cm}$ apart. With what force do $2\ \mathrm{m}$ long segments of the conductors interact ($\mathrm{mN}$)?
question_uz: Vakuumda bir-biridan $5\ \mathrm{cm}$ masofada joylashgan ikki uzun parallel o'tkazgichdan $10\ \mathrm{A}$ va $15\ \mathrm{A}$ tok o'tmoqda. O'tkazgichlarning $2\ \mathrm{m}$ uzunlikdagi qismlari qanday kuch bilan ta'sirlashadi ($\mathrm{mN}$)?
question_ru: В вакууме по двум длинным параллельным проводникам, находящимся на расстоянии $5\ \mathrm{cm}$ друг от друга, текут токи $10\ \mathrm{A}$ и $15\ \mathrm{A}$. С какой силой взаимодействуют участки проводников длиной $2\ \mathrm{m}$ ($\mathrm{mN}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. F = 2·10⁻⁷·I₁I₂l/d = 2·10⁻⁷·10·15·2/0,05 = 1,2·10⁻³ N = 1,2 mN.
Asos: parallel toklarning o'zaro ta'siri.

distractors_en.B: the length was taken as 1 m
distractors_en.C: the 2π in the denominator was dropped
distractors_en.D: the distance was left in centimetres

question_en: A current of $4\ \mathrm{A}$ flows in a wire ring of radius $10\ \mathrm{cm}$. The ring is in a uniform field of induction $0.5\ \mathrm{T}$, its plane parallel to the field lines. Find the torque acting on the ring ($\mathrm{N\cdot m}$).
question_uz: Radiusi $10\ \mathrm{cm}$ bo'lgan sim halqadan $4\ \mathrm{A}$ tok o'tmoqda. Halqa induksiyasi $0.5\ \mathrm{T}$ bo'lgan bir jinsli maydonda, uning tekisligi induksiya chiziqlariga parallel. Halqaga ta'sir qiluvchi kuch momentini toping ($\mathrm{N\cdot m}$).
question_ru: По проволочному кольцу радиусом $10\ \mathrm{cm}$ течёт ток $4\ \mathrm{A}$. Кольцо находится в однородном поле с индукцией $0.5\ \mathrm{T}$, его плоскость параллельна линиям индукции. Найдите момент сил, действующий на кольцо ($\mathrm{N\cdot m}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Tekislik chiziqlarga parallel — normal ⟂ B, α = 90°: M = IπR²B = 4·π·0,01·0,5 = 0,02π N·m.
Asos: M = p(m)·B·sinα.

uz: Normal $\vec B$ ga perpendikulyar, $\alpha=90^\circ$: $$M=I\pi R^2B=4\cdot\pi\cdot0.01\cdot0.5=0.02\pi\ \mathrm{N\cdot m}$$
en: The normal is perpendicular to $\vec B$, $\alpha=90^\circ$: $$M=I\pi R^2B=4\cdot\pi\cdot0.01\cdot0.5=0.02\pi\ \mathrm{N\cdot m}$$

distractors.A: tekislik parallel bo'lgani uchun moment nol deb olingan
distractors.C: yuz o'rniga πR olingan (R kvadratga ko'tarilmagan)

distractors_ru.A: момент принят нулевым, так как плоскость параллельна
distractors_ru.C: вместо площади взято πR (R не возведён в квадрат)

distractors_en.A: the torque was taken as zero because the plane is parallel
distractors_en.B: the result was multiplied by two
distractors_en.C: πR was used instead of the area (R not squared)
distractors_en.E: the result was divided by two

question_en: A horizontal conductor of mass $20\ \mathrm{g}$ and length $50\ \mathrm{cm}$ hangs on two threads in a vertical field of induction $0.2\ \mathrm{T}$. At what current will the threads deflect $45^\circ$ from the vertical ($\mathrm{A}$)? $g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
question_uz: Massasi $20\ \mathrm{g}$, uzunligi $50\ \mathrm{cm}$ bo'lgan gorizontal o'tkazgich ikki ipga osilgan va induksiyasi $0.2\ \mathrm{T}$ bo'lgan vertikal maydonda turibdi. O'tkazgichdan qanday tok o'tganda iplar vertikaldan $45^\circ$ ga og'adi ($\mathrm{A}$)? $g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
question_ru: Горизонтальный проводник массой $20\ \mathrm{g}$ и длиной $50\ \mathrm{cm}$ подвешен на двух нитях и находится в вертикальном поле с индукцией $0.2\ \mathrm{T}$. При каком токе нити отклонятся от вертикали на $45^\circ$ ($\mathrm{A}$)? $g=10\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. tgβ = IBl/(mg) ⇒ I = mg·tg45°/(Bl) = 0,2·1/(0,2·0,5) = 2 A.
Asos: osilgan o'tkazgich muvozanati.

distractors_ru.A: сила тяжести поделена на две нити

distractors_en.A: the weight was split between the two threads
distractors_en.B: 1/cosβ was used instead of the tangent
distractors_en.C: the result was doubled for the two threads
distractors_en.D: the sine was used instead of the tangent
